notes.title: Shadows: Awakening update 1.3 has been released!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30366564/d72428e4f71c8621664f5492117ce0541dfe0adb.png[/img]

The Devourer never rests, and has summoned a new free content update for Shadows: Awakening!

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list][*]Added additional free key binding functionality.
[*]Added Nintendo Switch Pro Controller support.
[*]Added Windowed Fullscreen Mode.
[*]Added resolution up- and downscaling support.[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue with the Chromaton Golem’s ‘Grapplehook’ ability. (DLC: The Chromaton Chronicle)
[*]Fixed an issue where legendary items would be dropped twice.
[*]Several additional bugs and glitches fixed.[/list]

notes.title: Shadows: Awakening - Free Update 1.2 brings Halloween to the Heretic Kingdoms, adds customizable key binding and much more.
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30366564/d72428e4f71c8621664f5492117ce0541dfe0adb.png[/img]

The Devourer never rests, and has summoned a new free content update for Shadows: Awakening!
The free 1.2 update for Shadows: Awakening brings all the tricks and treats of Halloween to the Heretic Kingdoms, adding customizable key binding and much more. 
Full details below:

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list][*]Added free key binding with selected functionality.
[*]Added drag & drop mechanic to the party screen.
[*]Added quick save and quick load functions.
[*]Added a skill and talent reset function.[/list]

[h1]New[/h1]
[list][*]Added 5 new additional legendary items to the game, each of which is named after some of the most active and helpful users on the Steam discussion boards.
[*]Added a junk system to the inventory to speed up the process of getting rid of unwanted items.
[*]Added the option to change difficulty at any time.[/list]

[h1]Halloween[/h1]
[list][*]Added Halloween decorations everywhere across the Heretic Kingdoms…among many other things.[/list]
[i]Hint: Trick or Treat.[/i]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list][*]Improved controls for the world map overview.
[*]Improved walking animations for Kalig.
[*]Improved boulder-pushing mechanics throughout the game.
[*]Several improvements for the HUD.
[*]Several improvements for the party screen.
[*]Saved games can now be individually named.[/list]

notes.title: Shadows: Awakening Update 1.13 released!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30366564/d72428e4f71c8621664f5492117ce0541dfe0adb.png[/img]

The Devourer never rests, and has summoned a new hotfix for the PC version of Shadows: Awakening!
Please find more details below:

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list][*]We have improved the GUI controls when using a gamepad.[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]We have fixed a bug, which made it possible to equip an item into an incorrect slot.
[*]Additionally, we have fixed a bug, which caused items to disappear when escaping from prison.
[*]Another bug has been fixed with the ‘Guild of Steel’ puzzle.
[*]We have also fixed a bug, which caused ‘Imperial Tombs’ sarcophaguses to be non-interactive after saving and loading in certain situations.
[*]We have fixed invisible walls in ‘Burial Grounds’.
[*]We have fixed a bug, which made it possible to kill certain NPCs under special conditions.
[*]We have also fixed the calculation for the offhand when dual wielding (e.g. Zaar), as reported by the community frequently.
[*]In addition, we have fixed a bug with the Blind Demon for the ‘Guild of Steel’ quest.
[*]Another bug has been fixed, when interacting with Graabak.
[*]We have fixed a bug for weapons with the ‘Slay’ attribute.
[*]We also have fixed a bug, when opening the Steam overlay while interacting with the Shadowtrader.
[*]Additionally, we have fixed some minor collision bugs.
[*]And we also have fixed some minor text and localisation bugs.[/list]

notes.title: Shadows: Awakening Beta Update brings new chapter and new characters
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/585450/Shadows_Awakening/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30366564/d72428e4f71c8621664f5492117ce0541dfe0adb.png[/img][/url]

[b]Changelog v1.0.6750.22812 - PC[/b]

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list][*]Added full Chapter 2.
[*]Added Zaar and Sebekan as playable characters.
[*]Added new Travelogues.
[*]Added German language support.
[*]Added stash functionality.
[*]Added new visuals for each skill level.
[*]Added ‘drop item’ and removed ‘destroy item’ function.[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list][*]UI graphics have been improved.
[*]Enchant system has been revamped and improved.
[*]Mouse and keyboard controls have been reworked.
[*]Quest rewards now show up on the screen.
[*]Talents can now be assigned via drag & drop.
[*]Item comparing system has been improved.
[*]Map system and visual design have been reworked.
[*]The quests system has received various improvements.
[*]Talents and skills system stat values have been reworked.
[*]Animations for playable characters have been improved.
[*]Tutorials have been reworked.[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed incorrect stats after a character has been resurrected.
[*]Fixed several instances of misplaced quest markers.
[*]Fixed lots of GUI bugs.
[*]Fixed lots of bugs related to changing between characters.[/list]


Not playing the Shadows: Awakening Beta, yet?
Get instant access here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/585450/Shadows_Awakening/
